subject: Sprint wrap: stakeholder asks, open gaps, and closure plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Lopez <elena.lopez@acmecloud.com>, Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sprint wrap: stakeholder asks, open gaps, and closure plan

Team —

Thanks for a productive weekly sync this morning. I promised a concise roll-up of the outstanding asks and a suggested closure plan so execs can review ahead of Friday's QBR prep session. Please skim and flag anything you think should move to the exec slide deck.

Top-line (for execs):
- Two product asks from Acme (data residency tuning + model audit access).
- One identified ramp risk: prefix-caching regressions on long-tail latency (affects 99p).
- Action owners assigned; target closure before next sprint end or call out as QBR exception.

Action summary (attached spreadsheet: sprint_gap_register.xlsx):
1) Acme: provide scoped KMS integration plan and docs (owner: Vivek) — ETA 2026-09-24.
2) Model audit: provide read-only KV cache traces for Acme's compliance team (owner: Karthik + Mina) — ETA 2026-09-28.
3) Latency: investigate prefix-cache regression and propose mitigation (owner: Ben) — quick triage by 2026-09-22.
4) Exec ask memo: short summary slide for QBR (owner: Marissa) — due 2026-09-23 (attached: exec_asks_summary.pdf).

Notes / dependencies:
- Procurement asked for an SLA carveout to cover dedicated pool isolation; Acme procurement on cc.
- If prefix-cache mitigation requires config change, we'll need a short maintenance window (ops lead to signoff).

Please reply with brief confirmation and any schedule conflicts. If you are pushing a date, propose a new ETA and reason.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: sprint_gap_register.xlsx (spreadsheet), exec_asks_summary.pdf (summary PDF)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Lopez <elena.lopez@acmecloud.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint wrap: stakeholder asks, open gaps, and closure plan

Marissa — confirming I've picked up the KMS integration scope. Quick clarifications:
- I will propose two options in the plan: (A) customer-managed KMS with limited key-wrapping, (B) Redwood-managed KMS with per-tenant keys. Option A adds ~2 weeks to delivery (procurement + legal).
- Acme's procurement asked whether we can show an HSM-backed flow; I can add a short appendix.

ETA: initial plan and draft architecture doc by 2026-09-24 as requested. If Acme wants HSM detail we push to 2026-10-01.

Mina / Karthik — for the model audit traces, do we have any PII redaction guidance for logs? I'll lean on you both for the minimal safe trace set.

Vivek
VP, Product Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Lopez <elena.lopez@acmecloud.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acmecloud.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint wrap: stakeholder asks, open gaps, and closure plan

Marissa / Vivek —

Thanks for the clear run-down. A couple quick items from Acme:
1) KMS: Acme prefers option A (customer-managed) but needs confirmation that key rotation won't disrupt live sessions; please call that out in the doc.
2) Audit traces: we only need read-only KV-cache visibility tied to request IDs for our security team; no raw prompt content. If you can confirm redaction, that'll help us move procurement quicker.

Timing: procurement is trying to align contracts this week — if you can get the KMS architecture + note on rotation impact by Thu EOD (2026-09-23) that would let us include it in our procurement ask.

Elena Lopez
Senior Security Program Manager
Acme Cloud
elena.lopez@acmecloud.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Lopez <elena.lopez@acmecloud.com>, Acme Procurement <acme-procurement@acmecloud.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sprint wrap: stakeholder asks, open gaps, and closure plan

Thanks all — solid progress. Quick updates and exec-ask framing for Friday: please read.

Updates: 
- Vivek: acknowledged — include explicit note on rotation behavior and a short rollback plan in the doc. Keep Option A primary.
- Karthik + Mina: please share the proposed redaction checklist by 2026-09-24; keep logs scoped to request ID, timestamp, and model metadata only. No prompt text.
- Ben: triage on prefix-cache regressions shows a config-level descheduling bug; propose a hotfix (no full maintenance window) — target deploy 2026-09-23 02:00-03:00 PT. Ops lead (TBD) must OK, Ben to coordinate.

Exec ask (one slide, two bullets):
1) Customer request: KMS integration + audit traces (Acme) — proposed timeline and risks.
2) Production risk: prefix-cache regression affecting 99p latency — mitigation plan and monitoring.

I will add both bullets to the QBR pack and circulate the 1-slide memo after the redaction checklist and KMS note land. If anyone sees a need to elevate to an exec exception request (more than a slide), flag by Thu 10:00 PT.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, GTM Engineering
Redwood Inference
